authority: Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services

contradictions.subject: qualified-candidate-status
contradictions.priorState: The registry preserved Florida Rule 5B-57.007 as blocked pending exact retained bytes and row-level review.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The official rule page presents the September 28, 2020 document as the latest final adopted rule. The exact 32256-byte official document was stable across three independent probes, retained, hashed, and deterministically parsed into 105 list rows.
contradictions.resolution: The source is operational. Fifty-four exact catalog binomials establish Florida regulatory applicability; all other taxonomy and regulatory context remains blocked.

contradictions.subject: pending-rulemaking
contradictions.priorState: The official history page includes later proposal and meeting records.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The same page separately identifies the September 28, 2020 text as the latest final adopted rule.
contradictions.resolution: Only the latest final adopted document is operative for this review. Later proposals are preserved as pending history and do not alter effective applicability.

contradictions.subject: exceptions-and-conditions
contradictions.priorState: The rule contains genus rows, named native exceptions, a species exception, a Salvinia exception, and two Ligustrum cultivar conditions.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Fifty-one of 105 list rows do not pass the exact current catalog-binomial gate, and twelve additional named exception or cultivar conditions require explicit scope review.
contradictions.resolution: All sixty-three rows remain blocked. Exceptions create no species-level not-applicability, and no list row creates county occurrence or negative evidence.
